text_block_list.text:
As Супер Крик struggles with her
health, an
unexpected savior comes to
her rescue during
summer camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Looks like you're really
strugglin' there,
Creek!

Well, I'm here to give ya a real
challenge! That's
right, I—

No I am not! I'm Creek's best pal,
Тамамо Кросс!
But ya know, ya got
great comedic timing!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Right! C'mon, Creek. Try and beat me at
a run
along the beach!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Huff... pant... My... legs...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Runnin' on fumes, huh? But you know
what ya
need at a time like this?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Drive! Ya got no get up and go 'cause
you're all
outta motivation!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Whatcha gonna do with a feeble drive
like that?
If ya wanna spoil your trainer,
then dig deep!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: For Trainer... For Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Gahhh...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Eh? What's all this about?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: ...I thought this might happen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, weird. I thought she just needed
some
drive.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: At this rate, you're never gonna beat me.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Huff... wheeze... I'm sorry... I'm so, so sorry...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I want to do my best for you... but I just
don't
have the energy...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list:
If you can't do it on your own, why don't we run
as a team?

text_block_list.text: Huh? As a team?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
What's that now? Are the two of ya
gonna run a
relay?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Weird... I don't see how a trainer's gonna
be much
help in an Umamusume race.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
But whatever. I'll give ya a li'l handicap
then. Ya
can have a head start!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик should be the anchor leg,
so I'll start
with an all-out sprint!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whaaa?! You're pretty fast! Not bad!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Since when were you this fit, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
My own strength and stamina have
increased over
the time I've spent with
Super Creek—which
means...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that'll do for your handicap. If
you're
gonna push that hard, then I'm
gonna get down to
business too!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Тамамо Кросс overtakes me in an
instant, but I
still keep running,
squeezing out every last ounce
of
energy I have...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer! Come to me!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Traaaaineeerrr!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Dazed and winded, I pass the baton to
Super
Creek. At that moment...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, Tamtam!
YAAAAAHHHHH!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! The heck's up with Creek's
energy?!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: I can win. I'm going to win. I will win!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
With our powers combined, there's
nothing we
can't do!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
By the time I recover, the sun has
already set.
And the result?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Aww, nuts. Ya beat me, straight up. I
thought
your trainer would just slow ya
down for sure...
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
The handicap gave you an advantage,
and your
energy was wild, Creek. What
the heck
happened?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I don't know, but my chest didn't tighten
up like it
usually does, and it felt like my
body was moving
on its own...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: See, you should let me help you sometimes.

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I explain to her that feeling obligated to
shoulder
everything on her own is the
cause of her illness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When I tell her I want to help by having
her rely
on me a little more...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ohhh... So that's why...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
The idea that I have to work hard on
your behalf
is what caused all this, huh?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I get it now. Guess that means ya were
too
focused.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Sounds like Creek to a T. Props to you
for figurin'
it out and helpin' her see.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
You've grown to be so capable, Trainer.
I can't
believe I didn't even realize that
myself...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: You're such a good trainer, and I'm such a bad Umamusume... Sniffle...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Together, we'll become an unstoppable team.

text_block_list.text:
Of course! Ah, right... There's more I'd
like to talk
to you about, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Tell me all about how strong you've
become,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, now that's what I like to see.
Happy for
ya, Creek!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hey! Are ya even listenin'?! I'm not just
some
background character in your
dramatic scene,
y'know!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I put together a looser
schedule for
the summer so that Super
Creek can relax.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Several weeks later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we've been having a blast every
day. I
especially enjoyed feeding each
other at the
night market! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I almost wish this summer camp would
never end...
But that's the lazy part of
me talking.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: It's okay to feel that way.

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. You've given me the
opportunity to
really relax.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It feels like my whole body is slowly
recovering...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
She has the same smile as when I first
met her. I've
finally been able to do
something for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But our summer camp isn't over yet. How
do you
want to spend the rest of it?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Let's go on a ghost hunt.

text_block_list.text:
A sumo wrestling tournament? You mean
on the
beach? Hehe, great idea! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
But I'm not going to lose! I'll squeeze
you tightly
and roll you onto the ground!
Hehehe!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
A ghost hunt? I don't mind, but I have
pretty slow
reactions.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Like, it takes me a while to realize
whenever a
ghost pops out at me.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Because of that, my screams are always a
few
seconds late, so don't laugh at me,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
We take it easy for the rest of our time
together.
Super Creek builds up her
power while enjoying
herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she reacts to all the scares
just as she
described. But the more she
has fun, the more
courageous she
becomes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
